source: Written 2026-10-16 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall via carddb --verify, fetched 2026-10-16) for every card a scene shows or names, Scryfall's rulings (Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire; Avacyn, Angel of Horror; Twilight Diviner; Gray Merchant of Asphodel; Bone Shredder; Fleshbag Marauder; Tom, Bert, and William; Blasphemous Act; Archon of Cruelty; Woe Strider; Yahenni, Undying Partisan; Temple of Malice; Haunted Crossroads, Carrion Feeder, Villainous Wrath, Grave Titan, Lys Alana Informant, Undergrowth Recon, Snakeskin Veil and Sol Ring have none published) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named; the wipe clip stipulates that their four creatures have toughness 13 or less. Power and toughness are Scryfall's printed values (Vaevictis 6/6, Avacyn 8/8, Archon of Cruelty 6/6, Grave Titan 6/6, Gray Merchant 2/4, Tom, Bert, and William 5/5, Bone Shredder 1/1); the 0/1 Goat (Woe Strider) and the 2/2 Zombies (Grave Titan) are oracle text. Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7). Vaevictis: you must target one of your own permanents too, and the trigger resolves in the declare attackers step, before blockers, so a creature you take can't block and a creature an opponent reveals may (rulings). Stacking the top: Woe Strider's scry, the surveils on entering and Temple of Malice's scry (played before combat) each leave a known top card; Read the Bones is left out on purpose, because it scries 2 and then draws two, in that order (oracle text; ruling), so it never leaves a known top card. Dies means put into a graveyard from the battlefield (CR 700.4), which is where a sacrificed permanent goes (CR 701.21a); Carrion Feeder's, Woe Strider's and Yahenni's costs have no mana and no tap symbol, so they can be activated whenever you have priority (CR 117.1b), in response to an exile spell included. Avacyn's trigger creates a delayed triggered ability that you control (CR 603.7, 603.7e), and an ability exists independently of its source (CR 113.7a), so the returns happen even when she has died too; if she dies with other nontoken creatures, she triggers for each, herself included (ruling; CR 603.10a). A return created during an end step waits for the next turn's end step (CR 513.2), so a creature sacrificed in the end step it came back in returns at the next one: Fleshbag Marauder, which may sacrifice itself (ruling), makes each player sacrifice at every end step. A card that changes zones is a new object (CR 400.7): a delayed return does nothing once the card has left the graveyard (CR 603.7c), and a returned Bone Shredder came under your control since your last upkeep, so its echo triggers again (CR 702.30a; paying echo is optional, ruling). Tokens: Avacyn's text says nontoken, and a token that has left the battlefield can't come back (CR 111.8). Devotion counts the black mana symbols in the mana costs of your permanents (CR 700.5), counted as the drain resolves, Gray Merchant itself included, and you gain the total lost (rulings); a token copy has the original's mana cost (CR 707.2), and the copy's own enter ability triggers (Twilight Diviner ruling). You order your own simultaneous triggers (CR 603.3b), and the last one put on the stack resolves first (CR 405.5): with Diviner's copy on top, both drains count 9 (Avacyn 3, Merchant 2, copy 2, Diviner 1, Feeder 1; Sol Ring and lands have no black symbols), and with the Merchant's return put on the stack first, it resolves last of the four and drains for 8 (Avacyn 3, Grave Titan 2, Merchant 2, Vaevictis 1). Blasphemous Act's reduction can't take it below {R}, and its total cost is locked in as you cast it (rulings; CR 601.2f); 13 damage is lethal to every creature shown (CR 704.5g). Moving a commander to the command zone is optional (CR 903.9a), and commander tax applies only to casts from the command zone (CR 903.8). A creature that returned at your end step has been yours since your next turn began, so it can attack (CR 302.6, 508.1a). Tom, Bert, and William use the sacrificed creature's power as it last existed on the battlefield (ruling). A spell whose only target is gone doesn't resolve (CR 608.2b), and hexproof makes Avacyn an illegal target for an opponent's spell (CR 702.11b).

scenes.head: Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire — the gamble
scenes.sub: A 6/6 flier for {3}{B}{R}{G}. Whenever he attacks, choose a target permanent for each player, you included. Each player sacrifices it.
scenes.say: Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire. Whenever he attacks, each player, you included, sacrifices a target permanent you choose.

scenes.head: Then each player reveals
scenes.sub: Each player who sacrificed reveals their top card, and puts it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card. Opponents too.
scenes.say: Then each player who sacrificed reveals their top card, and a permanent card goes onto the battlefield. Opponents too.

scenes.head: Turn 7: set your top card before combat
scenes.sub: [[Grave Titan]] is in your graveyard. [[Haunted Crossroads]], {B}: put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
scenes.say: Turn seven. Before combat, one black to Haunted Crossroads puts Grave Titan from your graveyard on top of your library.

scenes.head: Attack: their best permanents, and your Goat
scenes.sub: Choose each opponent's best permanent, and the 0/1 Goat token from [[Woe Strider]] as yours. It all resolves before blockers.
scenes.say: Attack. Choose each opponent's best permanent, and give up Woe Strider's Goat token. It all resolves before blockers.

scenes.head: Your reveal: [[Grave Titan]]
scenes.sub: Everyone sacrifices. Your top card is a permanent card, so the Titan goes onto the battlefield and makes two 2/2 black Zombies.
scenes.say: Everyone sacrifices, then reveals. Yours is Grave Titan: it goes onto the battlefield and makes two Zombies.

scenes.head: Their reveals are a gamble too
scenes.sub: A land or creature an opponent reveals enters too, and that creature can block. An instant or sorcery doesn't enter.
scenes.say: Their reveals are a gamble too. A land or creature they reveal enters, and that creature can block.

scenes.head: Nothing to stack? Scry and surveil
scenes.sub: [[Woe Strider]]: sacrifice another creature, scry 1. [[Twilight Diviner]] surveils 2 as it enters, [[Lys Alana Informant]] 1. [[Temple of Malice]] scries 1.
scenes.say: Nothing to stack? Woe Strider scries one per sacrifice, Twilight Diviner surveils two, Lys Alana Informant one, Temple of Malice one.

scenes.head: What you give him
scenes.sub: With [[Avacyn, Angel of Horror|Avacyn]] out, a nontoken creature: it returns at end step. Otherwise a token, or a land with [[Undergrowth Recon]] out.
scenes.say: For yours: with Avacyn out, a nontoken creature, which comes back. Otherwise a token, or a land with Undergrowth Recon.

scenes.head: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
scenes.sub: An 8/8 flier for {5}{B}{B}{B}. Whenever she or another nontoken creature you control dies, it returns at the beginning of the next end step.
scenes.say: Avacyn, Angel of Horror. Whenever she or another nontoken creature of yours dies, it comes back at the next end step.

scenes.head: A sacrifice is a death
scenes.sub: Dies means put into a graveyard from the battlefield. [[Carrion Feeder]], [[Woe Strider]] and [[Yahenni, Undying Partisan|Yahenni]] sacrifice for no mana, at instant speed.
scenes.say: A sacrifice is a death. Carrion Feeder, Woe Strider and Yahenni sacrifice creatures for free, at instant speed.

scenes.head: Turn 8: [[Gray Merchant of Asphodel]]
scenes.sub: Avacyn came down last turn. [[Sol Ring]] and three Swamps pay {3}{B}{B}. As it enters, each opponent loses life equal to your devotion to black.
scenes.say: Turn eight, Avacyn out since last turn. Sol Ring and three Swamps cast Gray Merchant: each opponent loses your devotion to black.

scenes.head: Devotion to black: 7
scenes.sub: Count the {B} in your permanents' costs: Avacyn 3, Merchant 2, Diviner 1, Feeder 1. Each opponent goes from 40 to 33; you gain 21.
scenes.say: Count the black symbols in your permanents' mana costs: seven. Each opponent drops to thirty-three, and you gain twenty-one.

scenes.head: Sacrifice it to [[Carrion Feeder]]
scenes.sub: The Merchant dies and the Feeder gets a +1/+1 counter. Avacyn triggers: the Merchant returns at the beginning of the next end step.
scenes.say: Sacrifice the Merchant to Carrion Feeder, for free. It died, so Avacyn returns it at the next end step.

scenes.head: End step: it returns, and Diviner copies it
scenes.sub: It entered from a graveyard, so [[Twilight Diviner]] makes a token copy (once each turn). Stack Diviner's trigger on top: it resolves first.
scenes.say: At end step the Merchant returns from your graveyard, and Twilight Diviner copies it. Stack Diviner's trigger on top.

scenes.head: Two drains of 9
scenes.sub: The token copies the Merchant's {3}{B}{B}, so devotion is 9 for both drains. Each opponent drops from 33 to 15, and you gain 54.
scenes.say: The copy has the Merchant's mana cost, so both drains count nine. Each opponent drops from thirty-three to fifteen.

scenes.head: Tokens never come back
scenes.sub: Avacyn returns nontoken creatures only. The card loops: sacrifice it before any end step, and it's back, and drains, at that end step.
scenes.say: Tokens never come back: Avacyn says nontoken. The card loops, though: sacrifice it each turn, and it drains again.

scenes.head: Bone Shredder: a kill every time it enters
scenes.sub: A 1/1 flier for {2}{B} with echo {2}{B}. When it enters, destroy target nonartifact, nonblack creature.
scenes.say: Bone Shredder: a one-one flier with echo. When it enters, destroy target nonartifact, nonblack creature.

scenes.head: Turn 9: cast it with Avacyn out
scenes.sub: Two Swamps and a Forest pay {2}{B}. It enters and destroys their best nonartifact, nonblack creature.
scenes.say: Turn nine, with Avacyn out. Two Swamps and a Forest cast Bone Shredder: it destroys their best nonartifact, nonblack creature.

scenes.head: Turn 10 upkeep: don't pay the echo
scenes.sub: Echo: at your upkeep, if it came under your control since your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay {2}{B}. Decline, and it dies.
scenes.say: Next upkeep, echo triggers: pay again, or sacrifice it. Don't pay. It dies, and Avacyn will return it at end step.

scenes.head: End step: it's back, and kills again
scenes.sub: Avacyn returns it at the beginning of your end step. Its enter trigger destroys another nonartifact, nonblack creature, for no mana.
scenes.say: At your end step it returns, and its enter trigger destroys another nonartifact, nonblack creature. No mana spent.

scenes.head: A new object, so echo re-arms
scenes.sub: It returned as a new object, so echo triggers again next upkeep. Decline each time: a free kill every turn of yours.
scenes.say: It's a new object, so echo triggers again. Decline each time: a free kill on every turn of yours.

scenes.head: [[Fleshbag Marauder]]: each player sacrifices
scenes.sub: {2}{B}: when it enters, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Yours can be Fleshbag itself (ruling): Avacyn returns it at end step.
scenes.say: Fleshbag Marauder: when it enters, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Yours can be Fleshbag itself, and Avacyn returns it.

scenes.head: End step: back, and everyone sacrifices again
scenes.sub: Fleshbag returns at the beginning of your end step. Each opponent sacrifices another creature, and you sacrifice Fleshbag again.
scenes.say: At your end step it returns. Each opponent sacrifices another creature, and you sacrifice Fleshbag again.

scenes.head: An edict at every end step
scenes.sub: A return set up during an end step waits for the next turn's end step. So Fleshbag makes every player sacrifice at every end step.
scenes.say: A return set up during an end step waits for the next turn's. So Fleshbag returns, and everyone sacrifices, at every end step.

scenes.head: [[Blasphemous Act]]: 13 to every creature
scenes.sub: A {8}{R} sorcery that costs {1} less for each creature on the battlefield. It deals 13 damage to each creature, yours included.
scenes.say: Blasphemous Act deals thirteen damage to each creature, yours included, and costs one less for each creature on the battlefield.

scenes.head: Main phase 2: ten creatures, so it costs {R}
scenes.sub: Vaevictis has attacked. Your six creatures and their four take off all eight generic, so one Mountain casts it.
scenes.say: Second main phase, after Vaevictis attacks. Ten creatures take off all eight generic, so one Mountain casts it.

scenes.head: All ten die; Avacyn triggers for each
scenes.sub: Avacyn dies with your three other nontoken creatures, so her ability triggers four times, herself included (ruling). Tokens don't count.
scenes.say: Thirteen damage kills all ten. Avacyn dies with your three other nontoken creatures, so she triggers four times, herself included.

scenes.head: Leave Vaevictis in the graveyard
scenes.sub: Moving a commander to the command zone is optional. Leave him there, and Avacyn returns him at end step: no commander tax.
scenes.say: Leave Vaevictis in the graveyard: the command zone is optional. Avacyn returns him at end step, with no commander tax.

scenes.head: End step: return the Merchant last
scenes.sub: All four returns trigger at once, and you order them. Put the Merchant's on the stack first: it resolves last, after the rest are back.
scenes.say: At the end step you order the four returns. Put the Merchant's on the stack first, so it resolves last.

scenes.head: Only your side comes back
scenes.sub: Avacyn, Vaevictis and [[Grave Titan]] return, and the Titan makes two Zombies. Then the Merchant drains 8: Avacyn 3, Titan 2, Merchant 2, Vaevictis 1.
scenes.say: Avacyn, Vaevictis and Grave Titan return, and the Titan makes two Zombies. Then the Merchant: devotion eight, so each opponent loses eight.

scenes.head: [[Villainous Wrath]] does the same
scenes.sub: {3}{B}{B}: target opponent loses life equal to the number of creatures they control, then destroy all creatures. Your nontoken creatures return.
scenes.say: Villainous Wrath does the same: target opponent loses a life per creature they control, then all creatures are destroyed.

scenes.head: Next turn, Vaevictis attacks again
scenes.sub: He returned at your end step, so he can attack next turn. Their creatures are gone; yours are back.
scenes.say: Next turn Vaevictis attacks again. Their creatures are gone, and yours are back.

scenes.head: Tom, Bert, and William: power into cards
scenes.sub: A 5/5 for {3}{B}{G}. {1}, sacrifice another creature: draw cards equal to its power, then discard a card.
scenes.say: Tom, Bert, and William. Pay one and sacrifice another creature: draw cards equal to its power, then discard a card.

scenes.head: Sacrifice [[Archon of Cruelty]]: draw 6
scenes.sub: With Avacyn out, a Swamp pays {1} and the 6/6 Archon goes: draw six, discard one. It returns at the next end step.
scenes.say: With Avacyn out, pay one and sacrifice the six-power Archon: draw six, discard one. It comes back at end step.

scenes.head: End step: the Archon returns and triggers
scenes.sub: Target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker, discards a card and loses 3 life. You draw a card and gain 3 life.
scenes.say: At end step the Archon returns: target opponent sacrifices, discards and loses three, and you draw and gain three.

scenes.head: An opponent aims exile at Avacyn
scenes.sub: Exiled, she never dies, so she'd never return. In response, sacrifice her to [[Carrion Feeder]]: no mana, any time you have priority.
scenes.say: An opponent aims exile at Avacyn. Exiled, she'd never return, so sacrifice her to Carrion Feeder in response.

scenes.head: She dies, so she comes back
scenes.sub: Sacrificed, she went from the battlefield to a graveyard: she died. With its only target gone, the exile spell doesn't resolve.
scenes.say: Sacrificed, she died, so she returns at the next end step. With its only target gone, the exile spell doesn't resolve.

scenes.head: The risk: exile from your graveyard
scenes.sub: Until the end step she's in your graveyard. If an opponent exiles her first, the return finds nothing: she's a new object.
scenes.say: The risk: until the end step she's in your graveyard. If an opponent exiles her first, she never comes back.

scenes.head: Against graveyard hate: [[Snakeskin Veil]]
scenes.sub: For {G}, a +1/+1 counter and hexproof until end of turn. Their exile spell loses its target, and Avacyn never leaves the battlefield.
scenes.say: Facing graveyard hate, use Snakeskin Veil instead: hexproof makes their exile spell lose its target, and Avacyn never leaves.

scenes.head: Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire
scenes.sub: Sacrifice, return, repeat · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire: sacrifice, return, repeat. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
